title: chore: add Ponytail coding skill
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the upstream Ponytail skill for repo coding work.
- Makes it available to Codex and Claude from one copy.
- Suggests it to contributors using coding agents for quests.

Checks: quest template YAML parsed; upstream skill and license hashes matched; symlinks resolved; diff whitespace check passed.

gist.headline: One skill, two coding agents
gist.blurb: Ponytail joins the contributor toolkit. Codex and Claude share one copy, and quest contributors get a pointer to it.
gist.summary: Added the upstream Ponytail coding skill once for both Codex and Claude, with guidance in the quest template and contributor docs for people using coding agents.
gist.impact: Contributors working on quests with Codex or Claude get the same Ponytail skill and a clear pointer to it.
gist.visual_concept: Ponytail is a shared coding skill, not a pony mascot. Show Polli guiding two friendly coding terminals labeled Codex and Claude toward one shared skill booklet, with code-plants around the desk.
